  • Own sensitive key export/import experiences and related safety rails.

  • Write and maintain high-signal, non-flaky tests (unit/integration/e2e) for critical paths; ensure safe rollouts via monitoring and staged releases.

You will be Phantom's outward-facing business leader — deepening and diversifying partnerships across crypto and traditional fintech to unlock and extend foundational capabilities, drive distribution and revenue, and develop the pipeline of inorganic opportunities that close capability gaps faster than we could build or hire. You'll sit within the Ops Org alongside BizOps and Communications — the business layer of Phantom — and serve as the internal expert that leadership reaches out to for everything from market intelligence to deal execution.

Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Partner with Product to launch and scale major business lines, unlocking foundational capabilities through strategic partnerships

  • Lead business development strategy across user growth, monetization, and platform expansion

  • Own revenue targets, measuring impact and deepening integration across the product stack

Corporate Development & Strategic Intelligence

  • Map the competitive landscape and build market intelligence that provides a real point of view on where the space is heading

  • Build and maintain a pipeline of inorganic options that close capability gaps and accelerate key metrics

  • Own deal processes end-to-end – sourcing, diligence, negotiation, closing, and integration

  • Deliver execution-ready recommendations, not research reports — every output actionable on receipt

Qualifications

  • A leader with 10+ years of experience spanning business development, partnerships, corporate development, M&A, or strategy — or a combination of investing and operator backgrounds

  • Deep knowledge of the crypto and/or fintech ecosystem, with a strong network in Solana and beyond; you are plugged in, get calls from founders and investors, and have a genuine point of view on where things are heading

  • Demonstrated track record of making calls that influenced executive decision-making or product direction — and driving action as a result

  • Meaningful deal experience across partnerships and/or M&A: you can speak to specific transactions, what you owned, and what you learned

  • A cross-functional operator — comfortable collaborating across Product, Engineering, Ops, Marketing, and Finance

  • A strategic negotiator — skilled at structuring deals with decentralized protocols, regulated financial players, and acquisition targets alike

  • Exceptional judgment and prioritization; ability to move at speed with 80/20 thinking — you know what to prioritize and what to deprioritize, and you don't confuse activity with impact

  • Strong written and verbal communication — crisp memos, curated analysis, clear narratives

  • Experience managing a lean team, or a proven high performer who can take on management duties

We strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that our work is stronger with a variety of perspectives, and we’re eager to further diversify our company. If you have a background that you feel would make an impact at Phantom, please consider applying. We’re committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best work of your career.

Phantom is the modern money app used by tens of millions around the world. Our product combines everything people need to manage, spend, and grow their money in one simple, intuitive experience. Phantom brings all the control and flexibility of crypto-powered finance, without unnecessary complexity, into mainstream consumer finance.

By combining industry-leading security with thoughtfully designed tools, Phantom makes powerful financial tools feel approachable and easy to use. This focus on speed, control, and user experience has fueled rapid growth, with a community of 20M+ people, reaching #1 in the Google Play Store finance category, and consistently ranking as a Top 50 app across all categories, alongside some of the most recognizable consumer technology platforms in the world.

As a Senior Copywriter on our brand creative team you’ll craft compelling and impactful copy that brings our brand to life across all channels. Your work will engage and inspire our global community, helping users understand and embrace Phantom the next generation of digital finance.

This is a general opening, based on your fit and marketing experience you could be working on projects across product, partnerships, brand, content, influencer, and experiential marketing. There will be a lot of space to conceive, own and drive initiatives with 20M+ monthly active users, Phantom is a rare opportunity to impact the experience of people at scale.

Responsibilities

  • Lead creative development of impactful copy, concepts, and campaigns across both product and brand marketing, ensuring alignment with our brand voice, tone, and creative direction.

  • Create high-quality marketing copy for all digital channels including website, email, social media, push notifications, in-app communications, blogs, newsletters, and press releases.

  • Generate innovative content ideas and conceptualize creative campaigns that drive brand engagement and align with business goals, ensuring that each piece of content is strategically designed to capture attention and deliver measurable impact across all channels.

  • Ensure brand consistency by maintaining our tone of voice across all communications, fostering a cohesive and unified user experience.

  • Oversee quality control to ensure messaging meets the highest standards, and optimize processes for efficiency and productivity to meet company-wide copy needs.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (including product, design, and engineering) to develop narratives that engage audiences and align with Phantom’s broader strategic vision.

  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends, audience insights, and competitive landscape to ensure our messaging stays relevant, fresh, and innovative.

  • Use data-driven insights to optimize copy performance and refine messaging, ensuring maximum impact and user engagement.

  • Adapt quickly to changes in business needs and audience preferences, ensuring the copy reflects evolving trends and demands.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a Copywriter or in a similar creative role, with a strong portfolio that demonstrates excellence in writing for digital marketing and brand communications.

  • Exceptional writing and editing skills with a keen eye for detail, tone, and voice.

  • Strong ability to adapt copy across different formats while maintaining consistency.

  • Excellent communication and storytelling abilities to convey product benefits effectively

  • Understanding of marketing principles and digital marketing tactics

  • Familiarity with data analytics tools and performance metrics to refine messaging.

  • Experience in the cryptocurrency, fintech, or tech industry is a plus, but not required.

  • A passion for creativity and innovation, with a solid understanding of how compelling storytelling drives engagement and action.

  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams without formal authority

Why Work with Us

Opportunity

We are a team of experienced builders in the blockchain and crypto industry. Our journey began from users seeking an easy, seamless path to accessing the crypto ecosystem. This passion fueled our exponential growth, allowing us to onboard over 20M+ active users in just over five years; with our user base growing weekly. Our dedication to a secure and seamless user experience has made us the leading wallet on Solana as well as our multi-chain approach enhances our platform's versatility, meeting the needs of a diverse and growing user base. By staying at the forefront of technology and user expectations, we continue to innovate and set industry standards on self-custodial crypto wallets.

There has never been a better time to work in crypto to help shape the future of innovation.

  • First impressions matter: Wallets are responsible for a users first impression with crypto and onboarding new users into crypto. By ensuring that a user has a great first-time experience with crypto, we can help supercharge the growth of the entire ecosystem.

  • Make crypto easier to navigate: There is no easy way for a user to discover and navigate all that crypto has to offer. Wallets have a unique opportunity to help users not only onboard to crypto but also stay retained by exploring new things to do.

  • We live in a multi-chain world: We currently support Solana, Ethereum, Polygon and Bitcoin with more networks to come in the new future. We are focused on creating a unified, multi-chain crypto experience for users.

Kit is the email marketing platform experts choose to grow their audience, deepen their relationships, and build a business around the work they love. For coaches, YouTubers, authors, podcasters, and other creatives, there isn't a better marketing hub to rely on to grow audiences, automate email marketing, and sell digital products — all within one platform.

More importantly, there isn't a team more committed to helping creators earn a living. We're on a mission to help creators earn $1 billion using our creator marketing platform. We have always been 100% independent and 100% remote.

We are proud to have built a product that our customers love, and we look for people who have enthusiasm and belief in our mission, vision, and values to join our team. We're also embracing AI thoughtfully — both in how we build and how we hire to ensure our team is adaptable, innovative, and ready for what's next.

The role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our builders team, which owns the core publishing platform for creators - how they create email templates, landing pages, forms, newsletter sites, and more. You’ll help enable creators to make and send high-impact, visually appealing, on-brand, and delightful content at scale. This is the core of our business - every creator's journey with Kit starts with building something, and we want that experience to be fast, flexible, and delightful.

You'll own key product surfaces end-to-end - from identifying opportunities to shipping products that touch hundreds of thousands of Creators and more than a billion subscribers.

This is a full-time senior IC role ideal for someone who thrives on creating high quality products, aligning the company on a broader vision and strategy, measuring impact, and is excited to shape how Kit shows up in the world - literally, in every email, page, and form a creator publishes.

 

Your support system

You'll report to Katie Swett Miller, our Chief Product Officer and collaborate closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Success, and Sales teams. You'll partner across functions to ensure alignment between product experiences and go-to-market efforts, while having access to a peer group of Product Managers across Kit for support and mentorship.

 

What you'll do

  • First Week: Dive into Kit's product ecosystem, the Builders surfaces (email editor, landing pages, forms, newsletter site), and current tooling for measuring content quality and creator output. Attend Get-To-Know-You (GTKY) meetings with cross-functional partners. Get access and learn key tools like Linear, Mixpanel, Omni, and our design/prototyping stack.

  • First Month: Build rituals. Dive into the products. Meet with a customer. Have shipped your first feature, partnering with engineering, design, and marketing closely.

  • First Six Months: Have an established POV on how we win in the industry. What success looks like for the team and the product space. And have engineers and the broader company understanding progress towards those goals.

  • First Year: Led major initiatives from conception through to successful launch. Impacted customers and the business.

 
 

What will S.E.T. you up for success

 

Skills

  • Data-informed decision making and quantitative analysis

  • Strong product judgment and prioritization

  • Systems thinking and building for scale

  • Deep collaboration with design on craft and visual quality

  • Cross-functional influence and collaboration

  • Strong AI fluency. Comfortable using AI tools daily in your own workflow and evaluating where AI can meaningfully improve a product

  • Clear written and verbal communication

  • Bonus if you have Publishing or content creation expertise

Experiences

  • 6-9+ years in product management with significant ownership of a core, revenue-driving product area.

  • Proven track record building high quality, scaled, software - ideally including creation tools, editors, or content/publishing surfaces.

  • Deep experience with content creation online

  • Partnered closely with design to drive long-term vision for a product area, including hands-on involvement in craft and visual polish

Traits

  • High ownership and autonomy in ambiguous environments

  • Comfort balancing short-term wins with long-term vision

  • Systems thinker who builds foundations, not just features

  • Low ego, strong collaborator who influences without authority

  • Intellectually curious with a bias toward learning

  • Clear communicator who can articulate strategy, tradeoffs, results at multiple levels

  • Customer-focused while maintaining business discipline

  • Strong taste and attention to craft - cares about how things look and feel, not just whether they function

 

What won't set you up for success

  • Seeking highly structured environments with predetermined solutions

  • Preferring tactics over systems thinking

  • Needing extensive direction to identify opportunities

  • Discomfort with setting goals and measuring outcomes and work against them

  • Difficulty distinguishing signal from noise in ambiguous situations

  • Indifference to visual/craft quality or treating design as an afterthought

 

Working hours and location

We're 100% remote with team members across the globe, but this role requires consistent overlap with our Engineering, Product, and Design teams across Europe and the U.S. The team has fixed meetings from 10:45–11:45 a.m. Eastern on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. We also ask team members to keep 12:00–2:00 p.m. Eastern generally available for recurring EPD meetings, planning sessions, our Team Call, and occasional project meetings. This window won't be filled with meetings every day, but we need the flexibility to schedule within it while both our European and West Coast teammates are online. Fridays are focus days, with no recurring meetings.

 

Compensation + perks + benefits

Kit has standardized salaries based on position, no matter where you live. For this role, we're hiring at our level 4 ($173,000). Level is determined based on experience and our interview process.

 

Perks + benefits include:

  • Profit Sharing

  • Kit equity

  • 401k with a 5% match

  • We cover up to $2,100 per month toward medical premiums, with dental and vision premiums fully covered. We offer Health Insurance plans through Aetna

  • $2,000 equipment allowance for your first two years, $1,000 budget every following two years. Company-provided laptops are issued to every Kit team member and are not included in the equipment budget

  • Individual learning + development budget ($3,500/year)

  • Gender affirming benefits

  • Childcare benefit up to $3,000 annually through JOON

  • Twenty (20) days of paid time off during each year of employment

  • Paid paid vacation: An after-tax bonus of $1,000 for taking five consecutive days of vacation where you’re fully unplugged from work

  • Ten (10) paid holidays a year

  • Two weeks of paid sick time each year, including mental health + well being days

  • Twelve (12) weeks paid parental leave and flexible scheduling in your child’s first year

  • Up to six weeks of paid bereavement leave, medical leave, and disaster after six months of employment, two weeks of each paid leave in your first six months

  • Winter Break Closure: Kit closes for a week at the end of December, giving everyone a collective break to enjoy the holiday season. Essential support services remain available, with teams coordinating to ensure coverage during this period

  • Four-week, paid sabbatical after five years with the team

  • Fantastic in-person or virtual retreats with the team twice a year

 

How to apply

We usually receive a large number of applications, and our goal is to follow up with you within two weeks. You’ll hear from us either way. Here’s what you can expect from the rest of our hiring process:

  1. A phone screen with our recruiter (30 min)

  2. Hiring manager interview (45 min)

  3. Take-home assignment

  4. Panel interview with cross functional stakeholders (60 min)

  5. Final interview (60 min)

 

We’ll keep you informed through every step. To get started, complete this application, including a cover letter and answers to the questions on the next page. We read every single application, and your cover letter and responses help put your experience into context.

About the role

Joining Cyberhaven offers a unique opportunity to be at the forefront of revolutionizing data protection through cutting-edge AI technology. Cyberhaven is dedicated to overcoming the challenges faced by traditional data security products, ensuring robust protection of critical data against insider threats in a rapidly evolving work environment. With a unique approach to data lineage, tracing data from its origin for better classification and protection, Cyberhaven combines the functionality of traditional data protection security tools into a single, more effective solution. This role not only allows you to contribute to the advancement of cloud and data security but also places you within a team of security and product professionals passionate about transforming the way data is protected.

What you'll do

  • Design and implement components of our state-of-the-art system sensor that traces all data movement across all applications and files on macOS endpoints

  • Solve challenging performance optimization problems: we’re building software that monitors hundreds of thousands of events with minimal impact on performance of the endpoint applications

  • Design and build highly reliable code that never impacts the end-user experience

  • Build secure-by-design hardened software that must withstand real-world attacks, while processing untrusted data and communicating with a backend over the internet

Who you are

  • Strong track record in working with Swift on macOS.

  • Experience of building system extensions using Endpoint security framework and Network extensions 

  • Prior work on at least one large native application deployed to tens of thousands of end-users

  • Experience debugging, profiling, and optimizing the performance of low-level system software using Instruments

  • Experience building endpoint security products, such as DLP or EDR applications.

  • Proficient in designing and implementing application architecture

  • Experience with agile development and SCRUM

  • Proven ability to collaborate with a distributed cross-functional team

  • Possess verbal and written communication skills in English

  • Availability to frequently communicate with a distributed engineering team in Central European and US Eastern time zones

  • Located in the following locations: Romania, India, Poland
